ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota Fraud Cases
ideas.description: This story would investigate the flow of money in the recent fraud cases in Minnesota, including the daycare owner and the man who stole $1.1mn from a meals scheme.
questions: How did the money flow in these cases?
Were there any shell companies or other entities involved?
ideas.insight: By following the money, we may be able to uncover a larger scheme or network of individuals involved in these fraud cases.
